title: Code Block Composer
summary: Visual and guided authoring, editable media, and reusable templates for interactive learning blocks.

content.business_need: Create and adapt interactive learning without reconstructing content, layout, and behavior for each block.
learning_objectives: Compose and refine an interactive learning block.
Adapt a guided pattern and prepare reusable media or template inputs.
content.design_approach: Separate visual composition, guided authoring, editable media, and template creation into connected paths.
content.development_process: Connect editable content and interaction state to a responsive learner preview; support saving, review, and block export.
outcomes: A visual authoring workspace and a guided route for mapped learning patterns.
LayerLift for reviewing editable media and Blueprint Builder for preparing reusable templates.
